validation.nameRequired: Enter your full name so we know who to call.
validation.nameDigits: Your name can't contain numbers. Did you type your phone here?
validation.nameTooShort: Your name is too short. Enter at least 2 letters.
validation.nameTooLong: Your name has {{count}} characters. The limit is {{max}}.
validation.emailRequired: Enter your email so we can get back to you.
validation.emailGreek: Email addresses use Latin characters. Your keyboard seems to be set to Greek.
validation.emailSpaces: An email can't contain spaces. Remove the spaces between characters.
validation.emailNoAt: The @ is missing. An email looks like name@gmail.com.
validation.emailManyAt: The email has more than one @. It needs exactly one.
validation.emailNoLocal: The name before the @ is missing, e.g. name@gmail.com.
validation.emailNoDomain: The part after the @ is missing, e.g. gmail.com.
validation.emailLocalChars: Before the @ only Latin letters, numbers and . _ - + are allowed.
validation.emailDots: Before the @ a dot can't be first, last or doubled.
validation.emailNoDot: The ending after the @ is missing, e.g. gmail.com instead of gmail.
validation.emailDomain: The part after the @ isn't valid. Check for double dots or a leading hyphen, e.g. gmail.com.
validation.emailTld: The ending after the last dot needs at least 2 letters, e.g. .gr or .com.
validation.emailTooLong: The email is too long. Check that nothing extra was pasted.
validation.phoneRequired: Enter a phone number so we can reach you if the appointment needs to change.
validation.phoneLetters: A phone number can't contain letters. Enter digits only.
validation.phoneChars: The phone number has characters that aren't allowed. Use digits, spaces, dashes and a leading +.
validation.phonePlus: The + goes only once, at the start, before the country code (e.g. +30).
validation.phonePrefix: Greek numbers start with 69 (mobile) or 2 (landline). For a number abroad, start with + and the country code.
validation.phoneTooShort: Digits are missing: you entered {{count}} of the {{total}} digits of a Greek number.
validation.phoneTooLong: Too many digits: you entered {{count}}, but a Greek number has {{total}}. You don't need +30.
validation.phoneIntlLength: A number abroad has {{min}} to {{max}} digits including the country code. You entered {{count}}.
validation.messageRequired: Write your message, e.g. what's bothering you or when we can call you.
validation.messageTooShort: The message is too short. Write at least {{min}} characters.
validation.messageTooLong: The message has {{count}} characters. The limit is {{max}}.
validation.notesTooLong: Your notes have {{count}} characters. The limit is {{max}}.
validation.consentContact: We need your consent to use your details and reply to your message.
validation.consentBooking: We need your consent to register the appointment with your details.
validation.fixFields: Fix the fields marked in red.
